# thetalake_workspace (Resource)

The workspace resource allows for the management of workspace settings within Theta Lake. Workspaces cannot be created or deleted via the API — use `terraform import thetalake_workspace.<name> <id>` to bring an existing workspace under Terraform management.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thetalake_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

data "thetalake_user" "bob" {
  email = "bob@example.com"
}

# Workspaces cannot be created via the API, so an existing workspace must be
# imported before Terraform can manage it. You can do this with:
# `terraform import thetalake_workspace.example id`, where id is the ID of the
# workspace to import.
resource "thetalake_workspace" "example" {
  allow_anonymous_via_shared_links   = false
  analysis_supervision_space_ids     = [1]
  audit_log_retention_period         = 365
  case_management_manager_assignment = false
  default_transcription_language     = "en"
  default_workspace_timezone         = "Etc/UTC"
  delete_on_expiration               = false
  hide_attachments_from_search       = false
  preferred_languages                = ["en", "es"]
  reauthenticate_on_network_change   = false
  shared_links_expiration_period     = 7
  show_system_messages_in_chat       = false
  use_name_matcher                   = true
  use_owner_only_space_matcher       = false
  user_ids = [
    data.thetalake_user.alice.id,
    data.thetalake_user.bob.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_anonymous_via_shared_links` (Boolean) Indicates the ability to share a link to records publicly
- `analysis_supervision_space_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of supervision spaces whose matching records will be analyzed for risky behaviors
- `audit_log_retention_period` (Number) The duration in days that audit logs for this workspace will be retained; null means the platform default is used
- `case_management_manager_assignment` (Boolean) Indicates if cases are managed by users who are manually or automatically assigned to them. If `false`, cases are managed by the supervision space manager for the participants in the case.
- `default_transcription_language` (String) The default language used for transcription if a record's language is unknown or not in the preferred language list
- `default_workspace_timezone` (String) The workspace's default timezone (e.g. `Etc/UTC`, `America/New_York`)
- `delete_on_expiration` (Boolean) Indicates if records in this workspace should be deleted when they expire from the archive
- `hide_attachments_from_search` (Boolean) Indicates if attachments will be shown in search results
- `preferred_languages` (List of String) An array of selected preferred language codes
- `reauthenticate_on_network_change` (Boolean) Indicates whether users will be forced to re-authenticate after changing networks
- `shared_links_expiration_period` (Number) The duration in days that shared links for this workspace will be valid
- `show_system_messages_in_chat` (Boolean) Indicates if system generated messages are shown in chat
- `use_name_matcher` (Boolean) Indicates if the workspace identity matching algorithm uses names
- `use_owner_only_space_matcher` (Boolean) Indicates if the workspace identity matching algorithm should stop after owner and then fall back to default
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of users assigned to this workspace. When set, Terraform will add or remove users to match the set. Omit this attribute to leave workspace membership unmanaged.

### Read-Only

- `analysis_supervision_spaces` (Attributes List) Supervision spaces whose matching records will be analyzed for risky behaviors (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--analysis_supervision_spaces))
- `created_at` (String) The created timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `description` (String) A description of the workspace
- `disabled` (Boolean) Indicates if the workspace is disabled
- `disabled_at` (String) The timestamp when the workspace was disabled, or null if not disabled, using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `id` (Number) The workspace ID
- `name` (String) The workspace name
- `updated_at` (String) The updated timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `users` (Attributes List) Users currently assigned to this workspace (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))
